title: FBR Faces Rs. 157 Billion Tax Shortfall for October 2026
excerpt: The Federal Board of Revenue faces a massive Rs. 157 billion tax collection shortfall with only one day left in October 2026.
body_html:
The Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) is confronting a substantial tax collection shortfall. With only a single day remaining, the organization faces a gap of Rs. 157 billion to reach its assigned target.

The revenue authority must bridge this significant difference before the end of the month to fulfill its scheduled objectives. Further details regarding the specific causes of the gap or the final end-of-month figures were not immediately detailed, leaving the focus on the remaining hours to recover the deficit.
